DinoValley

Grab your explorer hat! Walk through a valley full of friendly dinosaurs, say hi to every one, collect dino eggs to hatch on your own farm, and gather your friends along the way.

Choose your explorer
Walk: hold the arrow buttons, or use the arrow keys. Jump with ⤒ or the space bar.
Meet dinos: walk close and tap Say hi! to learn about them and fill your Dino Book.
Dino Farm: find sparkly dino eggs in the valley and hatch them on your farm. Feed the babies until they grow up.
